INVALID_INPUT.error: object_ids must be a list of 1 to 100 strings.

UNSUPPORTED.error: sampleChunks is not supported by this store

NOT_FOUND.error: No document with that objectId is stored in this collection.

RESERVED_ID.error: 'schema' is the collection's control record and cannot be removed.

COLLECTION_MISSING.error: The collection does not exist yet; add a document first.

STORE_ERROR.error: OperationalError: the store did not answer

DIMENSION_MISMATCH.error: The vector has 768 values; this collection stores 384.

MODEL_MISMATCH.error: The vector was made with another embedding model than this collection.

NO_EMBEDDER.error: No embedding node is bound to this store; pass a vector instead of a query.

LIMIT_EXCEEDED.error: Light mode is limited to 5000 points.

SAMPLE_EXPIRED.error: The sample is no longer held by the node. Draw the sample again.

BUSY.error: Another sample or projection is running on this store; try again when it ends.

TIMEOUT.error: The sample did not finish within 60 s.

RATE_LIMITED.error: Too many embed calls on this task; try again in 12 s.

WRITES_DISABLED.error: Removing documents is turned off on this store node (allow_writes).

WRITES_SOURCE.error: Only a Tools source may remove documents.

WRITES_BROADCAST.error: The store refused this request: name the node the write is for.

WRITES_UNKNOWN_CALLER.error: The engine did not identify this request, so the store refused the write.
